comparison: Same-seed exclusive consuming merge; grow/keep bucket choices each with left-only versus left-then-right fitting reuse. Six real Abseil vector/inline-vector controls: reserve2n, known-union reserve, automatic. Smaller ns per source entry is better. All comparison cohorts on same job/CPU; postreads and allocated bytes retained. Raw repetitions remain recoverable from job artifacts.
decision: Select right-fitting reuse by default when fitting reuse is enabled on Zen5, Granite Rapids and NeoverseV2, following all three native audits and Ikea review. Explicit ReuseRight=false retains left-only reuse; unknown CPU profiles default off. Independent grow/keep caller choice unchanged. All shared-domain MM64 cells win, disjoint MM64 still loses. More sparse source blocks remain allocated; measured postreads are broadly stable but prolonged memory pressure remains unpriced.

results.scope: Exclusive consuming worker merge: unchanged control, deferred fitting appends, one-pass joined reservations, and both together. Actual Abseil vector and InlinedVector<Value,1> consuming controls. Includes destination construction, duplicate concatenation, source teardown. Per source entry across both workers; full ordered bags and postreads checked. No concurrent/retained authority claim.
results.right_reuse_scope: Right-fitting reuse is attempted only after the left does not fit. The deferred no-fail commit shifts right values with memmove then prepends left values. Full ordered outputs, selected source address preservation and late-failure full-capacity snapshots are checked. Both grow/keep controls retain left-only reuse. Pool/block retention and postreads remain measured; no runtime overlap estimator.
results.capacity_policy_scope: Candidate consume_keep preserves source bucket count/encoding; consume_fit_bulk doubles it. Abseil vector and inline-vector controls each reserve2n, reserve the known union cardinality, or rely on automatic growth. All policies run at0/50/100% overlap; no automatic candidate policy is inferred. Union cardinality is available from the fixture, outside timing, for the informed Abseil control. This comparison does not price overlap estimation.
